credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach. Botanical reference: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Utricularia . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Utricularia vulgaris, floating (free-floating, rootless). LUNGING: the same lace trap mass and pale bladders below the water line, with an emergent stalk thrust up and out toward the foe carrying five bright yellow two-lipped flowers (spur, rounded lower lip, faint guide lines); a small coiled stolon tip trails behind. Water-green leaves in the dark slot, bright flower yellow in the mid slot; the water line is white highlights only. Gesture: VACUUM TRAP, one bladder is set, then snaps (inflates and gulps, a tiny white water swirl at its door), and the lace sways, rebounds and settles. Sport: bronze-red anthocyanin leaves of plants in sunny, nutrient-poor water, a natural colour form, not a named cultivar.
